title: Standing loader uses one physical cartridge; crew reacts to drive and recoil
caption: SOURCE CREW / PHYSICAL CARTRIDGE / CHASSIS RESPONSE WITNESS
input_audit: One ordinary gun-sight LMB discharge, then ordinary driver orders. The camera-only witness changes no crew, cartridge, damage, or vehicle state. Enemy return fire is deliberately held for animation diagnosis.
visual_acceptance: Loader stands and uses actual brass/case hand targets; inspect every phase and recorded hand errors.
One existing round leaves its source slot and remains a damageable cartridge through hand carry and ramming.
Anatomical limbs retain source lengths; reject hand misses, floor penetration, source material loss or body clipping.
After closing the breech the loader returns to the source periscope position.
Crew balances against drive/brake and discharge; parked bodies do not bob.
limitations: Accessible loader-side racks only; existing basket/breech movement envelope. Whole-body collision, finger grips and swept cartridge contact remain incomplete. State checks alone do not establish visual acceptance.
